errors.evidence: The line begins in the year 2000 at an approximate value of 0.95. The value 0.96 is explicitly labeled for the year 2001.
In 2002, the line reaches a peak value of approximately 1.00, it does not fall to 0.95.
While the value in 2004 is approximately 0.97, the trend is incorrect. The line falls from its peak of 1.00 in 2002; it does not rise to this point.
The value in 2006 is approximately 0.98, not 0.94. The trend is also described incorrectly; the line rises between 2005 and 2006.
The value in 2008 is approximately 0.975, not 0.98. The trend is also described incorrectly; the line falls between 2007 and 2008.
The value in 2010 is approximately 0.96, not 0.95.
This is an over-generalization. The line fluctuates significantly in this period, including a noticeable peak around 0.99 in 2012.
The value in 2016 is approximately 0.955, not 0.91.
